# Extract the reason for retirement from the 'time / retired' column
retirement_reasons = df['time / retired'].str.extract(r'([a-zA-Z\s\-]+)$')[0].str.strip()

# Count occurrences of each retirement reason
reason_counts = retirement_reasons.value_counts()

# Check if 'engine' is the most common retirement reason
answer = reason_counts.index[0] == 'engine' if len(reason_counts) > 0 else False
answer
